name: Agent Sandbox managed network policy
description: SandboxTemplate networking should remain controller-managed. The managed default blocks private and internal destinations but still permits public internet; it is not strict default-deny egress.
remediation: Set spec.networkPolicyManagement to Managed or omit it to use the API default. Use the separate strict-egress control when public internet must also be denied.
test: Flags SandboxTemplate resources that explicitly opt out with networkPolicyManagement: Unmanaged.
